title: The Hours Between
summary: From a Taipei arcade, watch a grandfather and a schoolgirl share an umbrella. Drag to revisit the moment a bus passes between you, or tap a streetlamp to cast a little light on the wet pavement.
summaryZhTW: 站在臺北的騎樓下，看祖孫倆共撐一把傘。公車駛過，短暫遮住了兩人的身影。滑動指尖，重看那一刻，或輕點路燈，讓燈光映在濕漉漉的路面上。
coverAlt: A schoolgirl reaches for her grandfather’s red umbrella as a cream-and-red bus leaves a rainy Taipei street.
controls: Drag or use the timeline to rewind. Tap the lamp, hibiscus or bin, or focus the street and press 1, 2 or 3. Sound and playback have separate controls.

approval.note: Creator requested a Possibility release following Stillwater.
